name: Security
question: Are we still getting pwned?
metric: Added to CISA's exploited list, last 12 months
trendLabel: Rolling 12-month total, with one point per month.
rule: Getting worse when more exploited vulnerabilities are listed than a year before.
scoreReason: Per git push: Down 44% since January 2024, when the data starts.
caution: The data behind this score starts in January 2024, so it misses the first 14 months after ChatGPT launched.
The score divides this count by git pushes. If AI agents are inflating the number of pushes, it can improve even if software is no more reliable.
